question: How many underage patients were examined during the course of the three-year period from 1990 to 1993?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient AS T1 INNER JOIN examination AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T2."Examination Date") BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T2."Examination Date") - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T1.birthday) < 18

question: How many powers does Amazo hero have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(hp.power_id) FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Amazo'

question: How many of the patients with the most serious thrombosis cases examined in 1997 are women?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM patient p JOIN examination e ON p.id = e.id WHERE e.thrombosis = 1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."Examination Date") = 1997 AND p.sex = 'F'

question: Based on posts posted by Community, calculate the percentage of posts that use the R language.
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t3.tagname = 'r' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(t1.id) AS percentage FROM users t1 INNER JOIN posthistory t2 ON t1.id = t2.userid INNER JOIN tags t3 ON t3.excerptpostid = t2.postid WHERE t1.displayname = 'Community'

question: Which card costs more converted mana, "Serra Angel" or "Shrine Keeper"?
sql: SELECT name FROM cards WHERE name IN ('Serra Angel', 'Shrine Keeper') ORDER BY convertedmanacost DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: Under whose administration is the school with the highest number of students scoring 1500 or more on the SAT? Indicate their full names.
sql: SELECT s.admfname1, s.admlname1, s.admfname2, s.admlname2, s.admfname3, s.admlname3 FROM satscores t JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.cdscode WHERE t.numge1500 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.numge1500 DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many posts does the user csgillespie own?
sql: SELECT COUNT(p.id) FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id WHERE u.displayname = 'csgillespie'

question: Please list the constructor names with 0 points at race 291.
sql: SELECT c.name FROM constructorstandings cs JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE cs.raceid = 291 AND cs.points = 0

question: What is the average age of the male patient with high cholesterol?
sql: SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday)) FROM patient p JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l."T-CHO" >= 250 AND p.sex = 'M'

question: What is the average score in writing for the schools that were opened after 1991 or closed before 2000? List the school names along with the score. Also, list the communication number of the schools if there is any.
sql: SELECT s.sname, s.avgscrwrite, sc.phone FROM schools sc INNER JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = sc.cdscode WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sc.opendate) > 1991 OR EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sc.closeddate) < 2000

question: For all the people who paid more than 29.00 per unit of product id No.5. Give their consumption status in the August of 2012.
sql: SELECT y.consumption FROM transactions_1k t JOIN yearmonth y ON t.customerid = y.customerid WHERE t.amount <> 0 AND t.price / NULLIF(t.amount, 0) > 29.00 AND t.productid = 5 AND y.date = '201208'
problem: The database rejected the query: division by zero

question: Please list the disparate time of the transactions taken place in the gas stations from chain no. 11.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.time FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.gasstationid = g.gasstationid WHERE g.chainid = 11

question: List the name of leagues in which the average goals by the home team is higher than the away team in the 2009/2010 season.
sql: SELECT l.name FROM league l JOIN match m ON l.id = m.league_id WHERE m.season = '2009/2010' GROUP BY l.id, l.name HAVING SUM(m.home_team_goal)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) > SUM(m.away_team_goal)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT m.id)

question: List the names of schools with more than 30 difference in enrollements between K-12 and ages 5-17? Please also give the full street adress of the schools.
sql: SELECT s.school, s.street FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30

question: What percentage of carcinogenic-type molecules does not contain fluorine?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element <> 'f' THEN m.molecule_id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) FROM atom a INNER JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+'

question: Among the patients with a normal Ig G level, how many of them have symptoms?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM patient p JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id JOIN examination e ON p.id = e.id WHERE l.igg > 900 AND l.igg < 2000 AND e.symptoms IS NOT NULL

question: Did Maya Mclean attend the 'Women's Soccer' event?
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE m.first_name = 'Maya' AND m.last_name = 'Mclean' AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS result

question: List all patients who were followed up at the outpatient clinic who underwent a laboratory test in October 1991 and had a total blood bilirubin level within the normal range.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM patient p JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.admission = '-' AND l.date >= '1991-10-01' AND l.date < '1991-11-01' AND l."T-BIL" < 2.0

question: Identify the gender of the superhero who has the ability of Phoenix Force.
sql: SELECT g.gender FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id JOIN gender g ON g.id = s.gender_id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force'

question: When did 'chl' cast its first vote in a post?
sql: SELECT MIN(v.creationdate) FROM votes v JOIN users u ON v.userid = u.id WHERE u.displayname = 'chl'

question: In Scotland Premier League, which away team won the most during the 2010 season?
sql: SELECT t.team_long_name FROM match m JOIN league l ON m.league_id = l.id JOIN team t ON t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND m.season = '2009/2010' AND m.away_team_goal - m.home_team_goal > 0 GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: In the branch where the second-highest number of crimes were committed in 1995 occurred, how many male clients are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND d.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district ORDER BY a15 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)

question: Give the user's reputation and up vote number of the user that commented "fine, you win :)".
sql: SELECT u.reputation, u.upvotes FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.userid WHERE c.text = 'fine, you win :)'

question: Which schools served a grade span of Kindergarten to 9th grade in the county of Los Angeles and what is its Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)?
sql: SELECT s.school, f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100 / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE s.county = 'Los Angeles' AND s.gsserved = 'K-9'

question: Among all the closed events, which event has the highest spend-to-budget ratio?
sql: SELECT e.event_name FROM event e JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.status = 'Closed' ORDER BY b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question:
What is the difference of the average ball control score between Abdou Diallo and Aaron Appindangoye
?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.ball_control ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.id ELSE NULL END) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.id ELSE NULL END) FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id

question: State the driver with the most points scored. Find his full name with that points.
sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname, ds.points FROM driverstandings ds JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = ds.driverid ORDER BY ds.points DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: What is the status of the event which bought "Post Cards, Posters" on 2019/8/20?
sql: SELECT b.event_status FROM budget b JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id WHERE e.expense_description = 'Post Cards, Posters' AND e.expense_date = '2019-08-20'

question: What is the percentage of molecules that are carcinogenic? Please provide your answer as a percentage with three decimal places.
sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numeric) * 100 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent FROM molecule

question: How many patients with a abnormal C-reactive protein don't have their data recorded?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM patient p JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.crp = '+' AND p.description IS NULL

question: Please list the product description of the products consumed in September, 2013.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.description FROM transactions_1k t JOIN products p ON t.productid = p.productid JOIN yearmonth y ON t.customerid = y.customerid WHERE y.date = '201309'

question: List all the card id and artist with unknown power which are legal for commander play format.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.artist FROM cards c JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE l.format = 'commander' AND l.status = 'Legal' AND (c.power = '*' OR c.power IS NULL)

question: What is Abomination's superpower?
sql: SELECT sp.power_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination'

question: What is the percentage of carbon in double-bond molecules?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN a.atom_id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) FROM atom a INNER JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '='

question: Who is the dumbest superhero?
sql: SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(ha2.attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute ha2 JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Intelligence')

question: Which is the most valuable post in 2010? Please give its id and the owner's display name.
sql: SELECT p.id, u.displayname FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.creaiondate) = 2010 AND p.favoritecount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.favoritecount DESC LIMIT 1

question: Please list the reference names of the drivers who are eliminated in the first period in race number 20.
sql: SELECT d.driverref FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON q.driverid = d.driverid WHERE q.raceid = 20 ORDER BY q.q1 DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average number of test takers from Fresno schools that opened between 1/1/1980 and 12/31/1980?
sql: SELECT AVG(s.numtsttakr) FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.cdscode WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sc.opendate) = 1980 AND sc.county = 'Fresno'

question: What are the valid e-mail addresses of the administrator of the school located in the San Bernardino county, City of San Bernardino City Unified that opened between 1/1/2009 to 12/31/2010 whose school types are public Intermediate/Middle Schools and Unified Schools?
sql: SELECT T2.admemail1, T2.admemail2 FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cdscode WHERE T2.county = 'San Bernardino' AND T2.city = 'San Bernardino' AND T2.doc = '54' AND T2.soc = '62' AND T2.opendate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND T1."District Name" = 'San Bernardino City Unified'

question: What are the speed in which attacks are put together of the top 4 teams with the highest build Up Play Speed?
sql: SELECT t.team_long_name, ta.buildupplayspeed FROM team_attributes ta JOIN team t ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id ORDER BY ta.buildupplayspeed DESC LIMIT 4

question: What is the average number of bonds the atoms with the element iodine have?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(c.bond_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) FROM atom a LEFT JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'i'

question: List down most tallest players' name.
sql: SELECT player_name FROM player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM player)

question: List the names of all the cards in the set Hour of Devastation and find the formats in which these cards are legal.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name, l.format FROM cards c JOIN sets s ON c.setcode = s.code JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid WHERE s.name = 'Hour of Devastation' AND l.status = 'Legal'

question: What is the average blood albumin level for female patients with a PLT greater than 400 who have been diagnosed with SLE?
sql: SELECT AVG(l.alb) FROM patient p JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.sex = 'F' AND l.plt > 400 AND p.diagnosis = 'SLE'

question: Among the comments with scores between 5 to 10, what is the percentage of the users with 0 up votes?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN u.upvotes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / COUNT(u.id) FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.userid = u.id WHERE c.score BETWEEN 5 AND 10

question: Identify superheroes who can control wind and list their names in alphabetical order.
sql: SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id WHERE p.power_name = 'Wind Control' ORDER BY s.superhero_name

question: Calculate the percentage of players who prefer left foot, who were born between 1987 and 1992.
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t2.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(t1.player_fifa_api_id) FROM player AS t1 INNER JOIN player_attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE SUBSTRING(t1.birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992'

question: Which element is the least numerous in non-carcinogenic molecules?
sql: SELECT a.element FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' GROUP BY a.element ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) ASC LIMIT 1

question: List out the account numbers of female clients who are oldest and has lowest average salary, calculate the gap between this lowest average salary with the highest average salary?
sql: WITH f AS (SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, d.a11 FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F'), target AS (SELECT client_id, a11 FROM f WHERE birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM f) AND a11 = (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM f WHERE birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM f))) SELECT DISTINCT dp.account_id, (SELECT MAX(a11) FROM district) - t.a11 AS salary_gap FROM target t JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = t.client_id

question: What is the foreign name of the card in French of type Creature, normal layout and black border color, by artist Matthew D. Wilson?
sql: SELECT f.name FROM cards c JOIN foreign_data f ON c.uuid = f.uuid WHERE f.language = 'French' AND c.types = 'Creature' AND c.layout = 'normal' AND c.bordercolor = 'black' AND c.artist = 'Matthew D. Wilson'

question: For the drivers who took part in the race in 1983/7/16, what's their race completion rate?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL THEN r.driverid END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(r.driverid) FROM races ra JOIN results r ON ra.raceid = r.raceid WHERE ra.date = '1983-07-16'

question: List out the no. of districts that have female average salary is more than 6000 but less than 10000?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) FROM district d JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.a11 > 6000 AND d.a11 < 10000

question: What are the budget category of the events located at MU 215 and a guest speaker type with a 0 budget spent?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT b.category FROM event e JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.location = 'MU 215' AND e.type = 'Guest Speaker' AND b.spent = 0

question: For the patients with an abnormal Ig M level, what is the most common disease they are diagnosed with?
sql: SELECT p.diagnosis FROM patient p JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.igm <= 40 OR l.igm >= 400 GROUP BY p.diagnosis ORDER BY COUNT(p.diagnosis) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the disease patient '30609' diagnosed with. List all the date of laboratory tests done for this patient.
sql: SELECT p.diagnosis, l.date FROM patient p JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.id = 30609

question: For all the drivers who finished the game in race No. 872, who is the youngest?
sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.raceid = 872 AND r.time IS NOT NULL AND r.time <> '' ORDER BY d.dob DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: Calculate the average overall rating of Pietro Marino.
sql: SELECT AVG(t1.overall_rating) FROM player_attributes t1 JOIN player t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t2.player_name = 'Pietro Marino'

question: Which superhero has the most durability published by Dark Horse Comics?
sql: SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics' AND a.attribute_name = 'Durability' ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the names of all races that occurred in the earliest recorded year and month.
sql: SELECT name FROM races WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MIN(date)) FROM races) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) = (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM MIN(date)) FROM races)

question: What is the Simplified Chinese translation of the name of the set "Eighth Edition"?
sql: SELECT st.translation FROM sets s JOIN set_translations st ON st.setcode = s.code WHERE s.name = 'Eighth Edition' AND st.language = 'Chinese Simplified'

question: List the long name of teams with above-average build-up play passing in 2012.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name FROM team t JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE substr(ta.date, 1, 4) = '2012' AND ta.buildupplaypassing > (SELECT CAST(SUM(ta2.buildupplaypassing) AS REAL) / COUNT(t2.id) FROM team t2 JOIN team_attributes ta2 ON t2.team_api_id = ta2.team_api_id WHERE substr(ta2.date, 1, 4) = '2012' AND ta2.buildupplaypassing IS NOT NULL)

question: For the patient who was diagnosed with SLE on 1994/2/19, what was his/her anti-Cardiolipin antibody concentration status on 1993/11/12?
sql: SELECT e."aCL IgA", e."aCL IgM" FROM examination e JOIN patient p ON e.id = p.id WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE' AND p.description = '1994-02-19' AND e."Examination Date" = '1993-11-12'

question: On what year did the youngest driver had his first qualifying race? Also state the name, date and time of the race.
sql: SELECT r.year, r.name, r.date, r.time FROM qualifying q JOIN races r ON q.raceid = r.raceid WHERE q.driverid = (SELECT driverid FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY r.date ASC LIMIT 1

question: Among all the atoms from 21 to 25, list all the molecules that are carcinogenic.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25' AND T2.label = '+'

question: Name the event with the highest amount spent on advertisement.
sql: SELECT e.event_name FROM event e JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement' ORDER BY b.spent DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: What percentage is Landon Donovan's overall rating higher than Jordan Bowery on 2013/7/12?
sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN pa.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' THEN pa.overall_rating ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN pa.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) AS percentage FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%' AND p.player_name IN ('Landon Donovan', 'Jordan Bowery')

question: What is the surname of the driver with the best lap time in race number 19 in the second qualifying period?
sql: SELECT d.surname FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON q.driverid = d.driverid WHERE q.raceid = 19 AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL AND q.q2 <> '' ORDER BY q.q2 ASC LIMIT 1

question: For the female client who was born in 1976/1/29, which district did she opened her account?
sql: SELECT d.a2 FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29'

question: List the names of virtual schools that are among the top 5 in their respective counties based on average reading scores.
sql: SELECT school FROM (SELECT s.school, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.county ORDER BY t.avgscrread DESC) AS rnk FROM schools s JOIN satscores t ON s.cdscode = t.cds WHERE s.virtual = 'F' AND t.avgscrread IS NOT NULL) x WHERE rnk <= 5

question: What is the composition of element chlorine in percentage among the single bond molecules?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.element = 'cl' THEN t.atom_id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(t.atom_id) FROM (SELECT a.atom_id, a.element FROM atom a INNER JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-') t

question: What was the notes of the fundraising on 2019/9/14?
sql: SELECT notes FROM income WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14'

question: State code numbers of top 3 yougest drivers. How many Netherlandic drivers among them?
sql: WITH top3 AS (SELECT code, nationality FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT code, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM top3 WHERE nationality = 'Dutch') AS dutch_count FROM top3

question: List out the full name and total cost that member id "rec4BLdZHS2Blfp4v" incurred?
sql: SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost FROM member m JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE m.member_id = 'rec4BLdZHS2Blfp4v' GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name

question: Where is Malaysian Grand Prix held? Give the location coordinates.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.lat, c.lng FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'

question: Name the user that commented 'thank you user93!'
sql: SELECT u.displayname FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.userid WHERE c.text = 'thank you user93!'

question: For the driver who set the fastest lap speed, what is his nationality?
sql: SELECT d.nationality FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND r.fastestlapspeed <> '' ORDER BY CAST(r.fastestlapspeed AS real) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List all the names of events that had an attendance of over 20 students but were not fundraisers.
sql: SELECT e.event_name FROM event e JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event WHERE e.type <> 'Fundraiser' GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 20

question: Give the name of the league had the most matches in the 2008/2009 season?
sql: SELECT l.name FROM match m JOIN league l ON l.id = m.league_id WHERE m.season = '2008/2009' GROUP BY l.id, l.name HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM match WHERE season = '2008/2009' GROUP BY league_id) t)

question: For the set of cards with "Ancestor's Chosen" in it, is there a Korean version of it?
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cards c JOIN set_translations st ON st.setcode = c.setcode WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND st.language = 'Korean' AND st.translation IS NOT NULL) THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END

question: Please list the account types that are not eligible for loans, and the average income of residents in the district where the account is located exceeds $8000 but is no more than $9000.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.type FROM district AS t JOIN account AS a ON t.district_id = a.district_id JOIN disp AS d ON a.account_id = d.account_id WHERE d.type <> 'OWNER' AND t.a11 > 8000 AND t.a11 <= 9000

question: How was Francesco Migliore's attacking work rate on 2015/5/1?
sql: SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate FROM player_attributes pa JOIN player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore' AND pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%'

question: Among the accounts who have approved loan date in 1997, list out the accounts that have the lowest approved amount and choose weekly issuance statement.
sql: SELECT a.account_id FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) = 1997 AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY l.amount ASC LIMIT 1

question: User No.23853 gave a comment to a post at 9:08:18 on 2013/7/12, was that post well-finished?
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.closeddate IS NULL THEN 'NOT well-finished' ELSE 'well-finished' END AS result FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON c.postid = p.id WHERE c.userid = 23853 AND c.creationdate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18'

question: From 2010 to 2015, what was the average overall rating of players who are higher than 170?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.overall_rating) AS REAL) / COUNT(t2.id) FROM player t1 JOIN player_attributes t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.height > 170 AND substr(t2.date, 1, 4) >= '2010' AND substr(t2.date, 1, 4) <= '2015'

question: Lists all types of cards in German.
sql: SELECT c.subtypes, c.supertypes FROM foreign_data f JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = f.uuid WHERE f.language = 'German' AND c.subtypes IS NOT NULL AND c.supertypes IS NOT NULL

question: Among the cards in the set "Hauptset Zehnte Edition", how many of them are designed by Adam Rex?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM cards c JOIN set_translations st ON st.setcode = c.setcode WHERE st.translation = 'Hauptset Zehnte Edition' AND c.artist = 'Adam Rex'

question: How many gold-eyed superheroes did Marvel Comics publish?
sql: SELECT COUNT(s.id) FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND c.colour = 'Gold'

question: Rank schools by their average score in Writing where the score is greater than 499, showing their charter numbers.
sql: SELECT s.charternum, ss.avgscrwrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.avgscrwrite DESC) AS writing_score_rank FROM schools s JOIN satscores ss ON s.cdscode = ss.cds WHERE ss.avgscrwrite > 499 AND s.charternum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY writing_score_rank

question: In superheroes with height between 150 to 180, what is the percentage of heroes published by Marvel Comics?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.id) FROM superhero s INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180

question: For all the club members from "Business" major, how many of them wear medium size t-shirt?
sql: SELECT COUNT(m.member_id) FROM member m JOIN major j ON m.link_to_major = j.major_id WHERE j.major_name = 'Business' AND m.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

question: What type of bond is there between the atoms TR004_8 and TR004_20?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id WHERE (c.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20') OR (c.atom_id = 'TR004_20' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8')

question: What's Angela Sanders's major?
sql: SELECT m.major_name FROM member mb JOIN major m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id WHERE mb.first_name = 'Angela' AND mb.last_name = 'Sanders'

question: What is the average lap time for Lewis Hamilton in the 2009 Malaysian Grand Prix?
sql: SELECT AVG(l.milliseconds) FROM laptimes l JOIN drivers d ON l.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races r ON l.raceid = r.raceid WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND r.year = 2009 AND r.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'

question: For artifact type of cards that do not have multiple faces on the same card, state its legalities status for vintage play format.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT l.status FROM cards c JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE c.types = 'Artifact' AND c.side IS NULL AND l.format = 'vintage'

question: How many schools with an average score in Math greater than 400 in the SAT test are exclusively virtual?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) FROM satscores sa JOIN schools s ON sa.cds = s.cdscode WHERE s.virtual = 'F' AND sa.avgscrmath > 400

question: For all the drivers who finished the game in race No. 592, who is the oldest?
sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.raceid = 592 AND r.time IS NOT NULL AND d.dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.dob ASC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total number of non-chartered schools in the county of Los Angeles with a percent (%) of eligible free meals for grades 1 through 12 that is less than 0.18%?
sql: SELECT COUNT(s.cdscode) FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE s.county = 'Los Angeles' AND s.charter = 0 AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100 / f."Enrollment (K-12)" < 0.18

question: What was the overall rating for Aaron Mooy on 2016/2/4?
sql: SELECT pa.overall_rating FROM player_attributes pa JOIN player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy' AND pa.date LIKE '2016-02-04%'

question: Provide the text of the latest 10 comments to the post with the title 'Analysing wind data with R' and the display name of the user who left it.
sql: SELECT c.text, u.displayname FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON c.postid = p.id LEFT JOIN users u ON c.userid = u.id WHERE p.title = 'Analysing wind data with R' ORDER BY c.creationdate DESC LIMIT 10

question: Among the players whose preferred foot was the left foot when attacking, how many of them would remain in his position when the team attacked?
sql: SELECT COUNT(player_api_id) FROM player_attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND attacking_work_rate = 'low'

question: For the user No.24, how many times is the number of his/her posts compared to his/her votes?
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE owneruserid = 24)::float / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE userid = 24), 0)

question: Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment of schools that are locally funded, list the names and DOC type of schools which has a difference above this average.
sql: SELECT s.school, s.doctype FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Locally funded' AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") FROM schools s2 JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.cdscode = f2.cdscode WHERE s2.fundingtype = 'Locally funded')

question: Please list the names of the players whose volley score and dribbling score are over 70.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.volleys > 70 AND pa.dribbling > 70

question: Give the coordinate position for Abu Dhabi Grand Prix.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.lat, c.lng FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'

question: Among the accounts who have loan validity more than 12 months, list out the accounts that have the highest approved amount and have account opening date in 1993.
sql: SELECT l.account_id FROM loan l JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.duration > 12 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.date) = 1993 ORDER BY l.amount DESC LIMIT 1

question: What number of patients with a degree of thrombosis level 2 and ANA pattern of only S, have a level of anti-Cardiolip in antibody (IgM) 20% higher than average?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM examination WHERE thrombosis = 2 AND "ANA Pattern" = 'S' AND "aCL IgM" > (SELECT AVG("aCL IgM") * 1.2 FROM examination WHERE thrombosis = 2 AND "ANA Pattern" = 'S')

question: Does the KSV Cercle Brugge team have a slow, balanced or fast speed class?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT ta.buildupplayspeedclass FROM team t JOIN team_attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'

question: What is the grade span offered in the school with the highest longitude?
sql: SELECT gsoffered FROM schools WHERE longitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ABS(longitude) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List out the account numbers of clients who are youngest and have highest average salary?
sql: SELECT d.account_id FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id ORDER BY c.birth_date DESC, di.a11 DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which race was Alex Yoong in when he was in track number less than 20?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.name FROM races r JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE d.forename = 'Alex' AND d.surname = 'Yoong' AND ds.position < 20

question: Which of these artists have designed a card in the set Coldsnap, Jeremy Jarvis, Aaron Miller or Chippy?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.artist FROM cards c JOIN sets s ON c.setcode = s.code WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' AND c.artist IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller', 'Chippy')

question: Among the patients who has a normal level of anti-centromere and a normal level of anti-SSB, how many of them are male?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM patient p JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.centromea IN ('-', '+-') AND l.ssb IN ('-', '+-') AND p.sex = 'M'

question: Name the races along with its circuit name and location for f1 races hosted in September 2005.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.name, c.name, c.location FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.date) = 2005 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.date) = 9

question: How many of the banned cards are white border?
sql: SELECT COUNT(c.id) FROM cards c JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE l.status = 'Banned' AND c.bordercolor = 'white'

question: Name the ID and age of patient with two or more laboratory examinations which show their hematoclit level exceeded the normal range.
sql: SELECT p.id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday) AS age FROM patient p WHERE p.id IN (SELECT l.id FROM laboratory l WHERE l.hct >= 52 GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(l.id) >= 2)

question: For all patients who are older than 55 years old, what is the percentage of female who has abnormal prothrombin time (PT)?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN l.pt >= 14 AND p.sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN l.pt >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM patient p JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday) > 55

question: What's the nationality of the customer who spent 548.4 in 2012/8/24?

question: Which top 4 leagues had the most games in the 2015-2016 season?
